title: ProspectingAgentRcmdTarget - Data API
description: Represents prospecting information suggested by generative AI. This object is available in API version 66.0 and later.

ExpirationDate.description: The date the recommendation expires, after which the recommendation is automatically deleted.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID associated with the owner of the AI-generated recommendation. The owner can be an individual user or a list. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

Rationale.description: The explanation of why the agent recommended the target contact or lead. The rationale provides context to guide users in their decision making.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: The status of the AI-generated recommendation. Possible values are: Accepted New – Default Rejected

TargetId.description: The ID associated with the contact or lead recommended by the AI agent. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

special_access_rules:
This object is available if Agentforce Prospecting is enabled in your org and your org has an Agentforce for Sales or an Agentforce for an Industry add-on license. To access this object, you need the Sales Agentic Prospecting Manager user permission.
